data.title: Palimpsest — censorship, China economy and model-eval observatory

entries.description: The deployed Palimpsest 1.9.1 boundary exposes six anonymous, read-only tools. It can discover public readings, inspect evidence-newsroom desks, request the bounded board verdict, and keep network and model-layer censorship distinct. Its query_economic_observations tool name does not override source rights: the static Pages publication treats CFETS/ChinaMoney values as restricted, and native MCP restriction-status behavior requires a separate deployment.
representativeQueries: Are China economic values currently publishable under the reviewed source policy?
Which static Pages publication-rights status must be checked before using the economic query tool?
What does Palimpsest currently observe about Stock Connect, and what cannot that channel establish?
Is the China economy evidence broad enough for a composite conclusion, or is the observatory abstaining?
Which Chinese information-control measurements are current, stale or missing?

metadata.deploymentNote: This card describes the exact deployed and independently re-probed MCP 1.9.1 boundary.
metadata.liveVersionAuthority: Initialize the linked MCP remote and compare serverInfo.version before treating a release as deployed.

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 discovery contract for static public readings. The current Pages publication exposes metadata-only China publication-rights status; the CFETS-derived observation ledger, Observatory index, economic pulse and named-series forecast artifacts are gated until they can be rebuilt without denied values or derivatives. Unaffected newsroom and evaluation records remain discoverable.
capabilities: inspect the UTC policy evaluation clock
representativeQueries: Why are current China money-market values unavailable from Pages?
Which source decisions are denied, allowed-but-empty, expired or not yet effective?
Confirm that restricted economic evidence is not being represented as zero, calm or directional.

metadata.versionAuthority: Read info.version from the linked OpenAPI document; it is independent of the deployed MCP release.

entries.description: Metadata-only restricted endpoint. The current reviewed policy denies publication of the CFETS/ChinaMoney value family, so no observations or derivatives are available here. The status preserves rights decisions and counts; restricted or unavailable is not zero, calm, healthy or directional.
representativeQueries: Why are China money-market values unavailable from this endpoint?
Which source decisions are denied, allowed-but-empty or expired?
At what UTC clock was the current publication-rights policy evaluated?

metadata.rights: The reviewed source policy is default-deny. No CFETS/ChinaMoney values or derivatives are redistributed without a recorded grant.
metadata.coverageBoundary: The status endpoint is metadata only and publishes zero observation records.

entries.description: Temporarily publication-gated machine index. Its current mixed artifact carries CFETS-derived material, so the same-path Pages endpoint is replaced by restriction metadata until a lineage-filtered rebuild can restore unaffected Stock Connect and route-discovery content.
representativeQueries: Why is the current mixed China index unavailable?
Which co-located Stock Connect content requires a filtered rebuild before it can return?
At what UTC clock were the current source-rights decisions evaluated?

metadata.freshnessAuthority: Read rights_evaluated_at from the publication-rights status; this catalog does not authorize or freeze an observation clock.

entries.displayName: Financial Evidence Agent Skill and Fleet Router
entries.description: Canonical Agent Skill that routes questions across Palimpsest China evidence, Seiche system funding and money/capital transmission, LiquiLens institution risk, and Undertow market-exit liquidity without collapsing their evidence boundaries.
capabilities: select canonical MCP and REST surfaces
representativeQueries: Which product should an agent call for China evidence, system funding, institution risk or exit liquidity?
Route a capital-market question without treating one product as universal coverage.
